# Security policy

If you have found a security issue, anything that gets the app to read or write
outside the paths it was granted, mail <phantom-builds@protonmail.com> instead
of opening an issue, so it can be fixed before it's public.

Include the app version from the About panel and enough detail to reproduce it.
Expect an acknowledgement within a week. FFtrim is one person's side project, so
fixes ship when they are ready rather than to a schedule.

Only the latest release is supported. There is no backporting to earlier
versions.
